scripts.dev:ai-worker: sh -c 'cd apps/ai-worker && unset AI_WORKER_MOCK_GENERATION; PY="$(test -x citigooapi/bin/python && echo citigooapi/bin/python || (command -v python3.13 || command -v python3))" && "$PY" -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001'
scripts.dev:all-frontend: concurrently -n seller,storefront -c green,magenta "npm run dev:seller" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,seller,storefront,ai -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev" "npm run dev:seller" "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:ai-worker"
scripts.dev:with-ops: concurrently -n backend,seller,storefront,ops,ai -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev" "npm run dev:seller" "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:ops" "npm run dev:ai-worker"
